en-US.description: AviSynth+ is an improved version of the AviSynth frameserver, with improved features and developer friendliness.
en-US.longDescription: AviSynth+ is a fork of the well-known frameserver, but with community contributions that avoided mainline inclusion until now. In the hope of modernizing AviSynth to meet present day needs and expectations, the project encourages everybody to help reach our goals: add long-sought features, energize the community, and improve developer and user friendliness. AviSynth+ is fully compatible with plugins and scripts written for AviSynth.
en-US.name: AviSynth+
en-US.releaseNotes:
A very brief summary of changes:
- Lots of stability and correctness fixes
- Added support for some new (YUV 4:4:0(:α), YUV 4:1:0(:α), Y+α) or expanded pixel formats (YUV 4:1:1)
- NEON acceleration for ARM64
- Frame properties can now be defined in advance or passed through when using plugins that do not support them by via new Get/SetFilterProps* functions
Refer to changelist376.rst for the full changelog.
